title: Feudal pyramid sheet
subject: History
unit: Spring 2: 1066 and the Normans (Misty Mountain, Sierra)
source: Written for history/y4 lesson 16 (Feudal pyramid sheet (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 16: Norman control: the feudal system. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

panels.title: Crushing rebellion
points: William's army destroyed villages and crops

keywords.def: a way of sharing land in return for loyalty and work
a powerful lord given land by the king
a soldier on a horse who served a lord

questions.q: What did a knight give in return for land?
Who was at the top of the feudal system?
How did the system help William?
questions.a: Everyone owed loyalty and service upwards to him

questions.q: Core: Draw the feudal pyramid and write what each group gave and got.
questions.a: A four-level pyramid with correct labels

questions.q: Extend: In the portal response box, write: 'The feudal system helped William control England because ...'
questions.a: Loyalty, soldiers and taxes all flowed to the king

questions.q: Stretch: Was the system fair to peasants? Give a reason each way.
questions.a: Fair: protection and land; unfair: hard work, little say

questions.q: Who did most of the farm work?
questions.a: C) Peasants. Peasants worked the land in return for protection and a small strip to farm.

questions.q: Big question: is it fair for a king to own all the land?
questions.a: A reasoned view: it gave order, but most people had little say
